verdict.rationale: PayPal documents registrable webhooks: HTTPS posts from PayPal to a listening URL you subscribe for your app whenever an event type occurs. That covers the core outbound-callback mechanism, but the pack says nothing about the reliability features this story centres on. missing for 10: signature verification of deliveries, automatic retry behavior, event/delivery logs, event replay/resend, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on signed webhook deliveries with automatic retries, event logs, and replay to keep my system consistent with payment state

citations.quote: Webhooks are HTTPS posts from PayPal to an endpoint on your server whenever the corresponding event type occurs
The initial setup for receiving webhooks is to subscribe a listening URL for a specific app
